MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.6
   C. 31
   D. 31.7

2. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.7
   C. 23.6
   D. 29

3. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 66
   C. 22
   D. 34

4. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 2/2
   B. They are equal
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 1/4

5. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 9
   C. 40.5
   D. 81

6. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 12x

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 42
   C. 90
   D. 21

8. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 27
   C. 27.6
   D. 33

9. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 2, 3, 6
   B. 1, 6
   C. 2, 4, 6
   D. 3, 6, 9

10. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 31
   D. 1

11. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 15
   C. 21
   D. 15.6

12. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x ≥ 0 only
   B. x = 5
   C. x < 5
   D. x > 5

13. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.6
   C. 19.7
   D. 19

14. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 37

15. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.025
   B. 0.205
   C. 2.5
   D. 0.25

16. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 1

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
